name: Text Diff
description: Compare two texts by line, word or character with side-by-side highlighting and patch export
help: Line mode shows both sides next to each other and highlights the exact words that changed within modified lines.
Word and character modes are handy for spotting small differences in a sentence or a config value.
Ignoring case and whitespace only affects the comparison; the original text is still shown.
“Copy patch” produces a standard unified diff ready for git apply or code review.
